title: Number Formatting
content: Implement number formatting utilities. Use Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware formatting. Patterns: thousands separators (1,234,567), decimal places (1,234.56), percentages (45.6%), currency ($1,234.00). Abbreviations: 1.2K, 3.5M, 1.2B for large numbers. Ordinals: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. File sizes: 1.5 KB, 2.3 MB, 1.1 GB. Duration: 2h 30m, 1d 5h. Compact notation: Intl compact display. Negative numbers: handle with parentheses or minus sign. Zero handling: display "0" or "-" based on context.

variants.simple: Format numbers with locale-aware thousands separators and abbreviations.

variants.advanced: Implement comprehensive number formatting utilities. Intl.NumberFormat usage: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options).format(number). Standard formats: decimal with separators (style: "decimal", maximumFractionDigits), currency (style: "currency", currency: "USD"), percentage (style: "percent"). Compact notation: notation: "compact" for 1.2K, 3.5M, 1.2B automatically. Custom abbreviations: function to handle thresholds (>=1e9: B, >=1e6: M, >=1e3: K) with specified decimal places. Ordinals: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th - Intl.PluralRules or manual mapping for suffix. File sizes: divide by 1024 progressively, format as bytes/KB/MB/GB/TB with 1-2 decimals. Duration formatting: break into days/hours/minutes/seconds, display relevant units (2h 30m for short, 2 hours 30 minutes for long). Significant figures: maximumSignificantDigits for scientific contexts. Negative handling: accounting style with parentheses vs minus sign. Edge cases: NaN, Infinity, null/undefined (return placeholder or "N/A"), very small decimals. Utility structure: formatNumber(value, options), formatCurrency(value, currency), formatPercent(value), formatFileSize(bytes), formatDuration(seconds). Locale: detect from browser or accept as parameter, fallback to "en-US". Memoization: cache Intl.NumberFormat instances for performance.
